item.title: More details emerge about FlyDubai co-pilot who tried to crash plane
item.description: Questions continue to swirl about the FlyDubai co-pilot who allegedly attacked the captain and tried to crash a packed flight from Dubai to Israel.

item.title: When to book Thanksgiving and Christmas flights for the best deals
item.description: Knowing when to buy plane tickets for holiday season travel can save you money. Here's the optimal time to book this year as airfares rise.

item.title: Battle with Iran-backed Houthis in Yemen tempers news on oil flow
item.description: Brent crude hovers around $100 a barrel despite news of increased Mideast oil flows, as Iran's Houthi allies battle over control of Red Sea shipping lanes.

item.title: Harlan Coben on what he's learned covering real-life crimes
item.description: "Harlan Coben's Final Twist" is back for a new season of shocking real-life mysteries. The author sits down with "CBS Mornings" to talk about it.

item.title: "Moneyball" author Michael Lewis tackles Elon Musk and DOGE in new book
item.description: Michael Lewis, who wrote "Moneyball," "The Big Short" and "The Blind Side," sits down with "CBS Mornings" to discuss his new book, "Blockers: Rebels in the Deep State," about Elon Musk's DOGE cuts and government layoffs at the beginning of President Trump's second term.

item.title: Israel was prepared to shoot down FlyDubai plane, sources say
item.description: Israel was ready to implement a long-practiced protocol after the captain of a FlyDubai plane was attacked in the cockpit, Israeli sources told CBS News.

item.title: Karoline Leavitt joining Fox News as a contributor
item.description: Former White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt will begin her new role at Fox News on Nov. 1.

item.title: Dennis Hastert, highest-ranking elected U.S. official to serve prison sentence, dies at 84
item.description: Dennis Hastert, a former House speaker who was jailed for violating banking laws, has died, an Illinois coroner said. He was 84.

item.title: Cornell president says university "must do better" as more details emerge about alleged gang rape
item.description: Cornell University President Michael Kotlikoff issued a video statement on the alleged gang rape at a fraternity house in 2024. The comments come as more details emerge about an apparent arrest at the Chi Phi house, and as questions linger about consent and the law. CBS News' Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Exclusive discounts from CBS Mornings Deals
item.description: On this edition of CBS Deals, we show you items that could help improve your everyday lifestyle. Visit cbsdeals.com to take advantage of these exclusive deals today. CBS earns commissions on purchases made through cbsdeals.com.

item.title: New poll estimates Democrats could take control of the House of Representatives
item.description: A recent CBS News poll shows how Americans are feeling ahead of the midterm elections. The battleground tracker estimates that Democrats have an advantage in the House and indicates that high prices and inflation continue to affect voters' thinking. CBS News' Anthony Salvanto reports.

item.title: Gatorade sold in dozens of states recalled due to undeclared dyes
item.description: Recalled Gatorade sold in 37 states could cause temporary "adverse health consequences," a federal regulatory agency says.

item.title: Supreme Court's new term begins today. Here's what to know.
item.description: The Supreme Court's new term is beginning with arguments on a major climate case. CBS News' Robecca Roiphe breaks down what to know.

item.title: Dennis Hastert, disgraced former House speaker, dies at 84
item.description: Former Speaker of the House Dennis Hastert represented Illinois for two decades in Congress and was later jailed on charges related to his concealment of hush money payments made to cover up sexual abuse.

item.title: Cornell police made drug arrest at Chi Phi 22 hours before alleged gang rape, log shows
item.description: The Cornell University Police Department made a drug arrest at the Chi Phi fraternity house less than a day before the alleged 2024 gang rape of Jane Doe, daily crime logs show. Meanwhile, the school's president, Michael Kotlikoff, released a video statement calling the case "deeply disturbing." Lilia Luciano reports.

item.title: Hero passengers on the terrifying FlyDubai flight detail how they saved the plane
item.description: The passengers who rushed the cockpit on the FlyDubai plane headed to Tel Aviv that was allegedly hijacked by its co-pilot spoke with Matt Gutman, detailing the ordeal.

item.title: Japanese leader calls woman's murder, allegedly by U.S. Marine, "heinous crime"
item.description: A woman's murder allegedly committed by a U.S. Marine​ in Okinawa is a "heinous crime," Japan's premier said on Monday, as the new accusation of violence involving American forces sparked public outrage.

item.title: Manslaughter sentence tossed after AI video of victim shown in court
item.description: In what's believed to be a first in U.S. courts, Pelkey's family used AI to create a video of his likeness to give him a voice.

item.title: U.S. Marine arrested, accused of killing Japanese woman in Okinawa
item.description: U.S. authorities in Japan acknowledged that a U.S. service member was in police custody and pledged to fully cooperate with the investigation.

item.title: Howie Mandel opens up about how OCD impacts his daily life
item.description: Howie Mandel sat down with David Begnaud for "The Person Who Believed In Me," where he opened up about how obsessive-compulsive disorder impacts his daily life, but also how it made the difference in his career.

item.title: What happens next in the botched Tennessee execution case?
item.description: The head of Tennessee's prison system will step down after the botched execution of Christa Pike last week. Gov. Bill Lee also announced an independent investigation will be conducted by a former U.S. attorney. Skyler Henry reports.

item.title: Federal appeals court pauses Minnesota's AI nudification ban
item.description: Minnesota's law banning AI "nudification" images has been put on hold after a federal appeals court sided with Elon Musk's artificial intelligence company.

item.title: FlyDubai alleged attacker was likely lone wolf, sources say
item.description: The man who allegedly attacked his co-pilot during a FlyDubai flight to Israel was apparently carrying out a lone-wolf attack, sources tell CBS News. Matt Gutman has more from the survivors who prevented a catastrophe.

item.title: Court throws out sentence over AI victim impact statement
item.description: An Arizona court has tossed out the sentence of a man convicted in a road rage killing due to an AI-generated video used to present the victim's impact statement. Jericka Duncan reports.

item.title: Supreme Court gears up for new term with major cases on climate change, guns
item.description: The Supreme Court kicks off its term Monday with cases involving climate change, President Trump's immigration policies and the Second Amendment among the most high-profile disputes.

item.title: Supreme Court hears case today on energy companies' bid to end climate suit
item.description: The Supreme Court is hearing arguments Monday over a bid by Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy to block a lawsuit filed by the city and county of Boulder over the effects of climate change.

item.title: Ex-Prince Andrew challenges validity of Epstein-related search warrants
item.description: Britain's former Prince Andrew is challenging the validity of search warrants issued for his homes prior to his arrest over his dealings with Jeffrey Epstein.

item.title: Extreme heat putting births in jeopardy, U.N. climate chief warns
item.description: Extreme heat is increasingly linked to problems such as premature births or underweight babies, the U.N. climate chief is warning.

item.title: Cat-stealing ring that took 2,700 pets for food busted by police
item.description: Fur removal machines, cat traps and measuring scales were among items confiscated during investigations into the alleged cat-stealing ring.

item.title: FBI arrests woman at LAX accused of being Chinese agent
item.description: Wanying "Heather" Zhang, an Irvine, California, realtor, was arrested on a charge of acting as an unregistered agent of a foreign government.
